verdicts.quote: one Lightning web component (provisional bundle `grokBotChat`) hosted on a custom tab inside a custom Lightning app. … the bot reads no records … the client can only send message text and prior turns
both Apex classes declared `with sharing`; the product runs no SOQL/DML on org data
verdicts.missing: The sharing mode is specified. Answering from records visible to the caller would require a rule for selecting those records as sources.

verdicts.quote: **Object CRUD and (d) field-level security:** not applicable by design: no SOQL/DML on org data.
verdicts.missing: The specification excludes record reads. It gives no field-permission check or rule for omitting or masking encrypted or restricted values in record-derived answers.

verdicts.where: AD-4, F-5, Actors, channels, state owners
verdicts.quote: the permission set `Grok_Bot_User` grants, in one place, the tab, the app, the Apex classes and the external-credential principal. … Org administrator (person) | Setup: enters the xAI key, edits settings, assigns the access grant
Transcript and history | the open component, memory | only that user's page; never sent to another user's client
Apex makes one synchronous HTTPS callout per user message … No DML precedes the callout
verdicts.missing: The design avoids uncommitted DML. It gives no trigger restriction or asynchronous job path for a trigger-initiated request.

verdicts.quote: Credential in a Named Credential backed by an External Credential (custom header), never in code or data … Apex never reads, builds or logs the key. … not deployable or retrievable as metadata
one callout's timeout ranges from 1 ms to 120,000 ms, default 10 s; at most 100 callouts per transaction. Heap limit for synchronous Apex (6 MB) **[U]**.
verdicts.missing: The Apex CPU-time ceiling is unspecified. The specification also flags its heap figure as unverified.

verdicts.quote: Apex tests use `HttpCalloutMock`; a mock proves the parse/classify/request-shape logic, not xAI's behavior or the credential.
Named Credential `Grok_API` (URL `https://api.x.ai`) + External Credential `Grok_API_Credential` … Apex addresses the endpoint as `callout:<NamedCredential>/<path>`.
the component calls `sendMessage` imperatively and awaits the promise. … after resolve with "ok" the pending row is replaced by the reply
verdicts.missing: Promise resolution signals completion of the original request. No mechanism delivers the result of work that finishes after that request returns.

verdicts.quote: a successful retry replaces the "not sent" marking with the normal turn. … the server has no dedupe, a repeat call is a new billable call by design
verdicts.missing: User-initiated retry reuses the transcript entry. There is no message identity or deduplication rule for redelivery of the same job.

verdicts.where: R-5 (A-5.1, A-5.3, A-5.4), shared error classes
verdicts.quote: Each class has its own visible text … E-TIMEOUT and E-NET respectively, both with Retry. … mock 500 -> E-UPSTREAM with Retry; mock 404 and 400 -> E-BAD without Retry.
mock 429 shows the E-RATE text and a Retry button. … No automatic retry of a failed send. The user retries explicitly.
whether an `incomplete` status exists. … if the call never returns, the platform timeout (R-9) ends it as E-TIMEOUT … produces E-TIMEOUT and E-NET respectively, both with Retry.
verdicts.missing: The timeout has a visible outcome. The specification leaves open how to recognize and label a truncated response that contains usable text.

verdicts.quote: "New chat" empties the transcript and history and returns to Empty. Leaving the page, reloading, or closing the tab ends the conversation permanently; nothing is stored in the org or in browser storage.
the bot reads no records … each request carries the system prompt, then the most recent history, then the new user message … users should not enter information they may not share with that provider.
The window is `History_Window` messages (default 20, PD-3). … the oldest **complete turns** (a user message with its reply) are dropped from the request until the count is at most the window
Empty; composer enabled; notice shown … a message that is empty or only whitespace is not sent … a message of 4,000 `a` characters is accepted (count 1); 4,001 `a` characters is rejected (count 0)
admin changes the model by editing one record … failures are diagnosable from the single diagnostic line of R-12 plus the platform's own debug log
verdicts.missing: The specification gives no deliberate org-wide on/off control or shutdown procedure that keeps the bot installed.

verdicts.quote: target is a development org only (a Developer Edition, sandbox or scratch org). A production org is refused … Deploy, key entry, and access-grant assignment are three separate steps
verdicts.missing: The development deployment is defined. There is no environment-by-environment configuration and credential policy or production code-coverage requirement.

verdicts.quote: `Timeout_Ms` (default 60,000) … a pending reply row with an accessible status "Grok is thinking". The pending state ends only when the call returns or fails, never on a timer
**designed empty, loading, error, not-ready and success states** … the five states render with distinct designed treatments … The UI shows the E-AUTH text, no Retry
pre-existing components, fields, automation and access in that org are unchanged. … the Apex source contains no `SELECT` against org data objects and no DML keyword
